name: Convex VOI Clipping via Weighted Sweep Graph
aliases: Convex VOI Clipping via Weighted Sweep Graph (WSG)
definition: A CPU-based clipping algorithm that intersects sampling planes against a convex Volume of Interest (VOI) to reduce GPU computation. The VOI is defined by a user via a carving approach using cutting planes.
summary: Convex VOI Clipping via Weighted Sweep Graph is a CPU-based algorithm that reduces GPU load by using a Weighted Sweep Graph to efficiently clip parallel sampling planes against a convex volume, avoiding redundant edge recomputation.
